title: Pedalling through the Golden Years
body: Vishav Driman, 65, and her husband Kamal Jeet, 69, discovered cycling after retirement. While people of their age were slowing down and watching sunsets from their front porches, the couple began with short daily rides and soon wanted to venture further. They knew the health risks of a strenuous activity at high altitude, but they had lived in Dehradun all their lives, were acclimatised to the cold winds and narrow winding roads, and knew most of the state's mountain trails. Encouraged by family and friends, they took part in cycling events and then decided to travel across Uttarakhand by bicycle. Their favourite trail runs about 100 km from Ghanta Ghar in Dehradun through Kimadi, Hathi Paon, Mussoorie and Chaar Dukaan to George Everest point, a route that offers steep slopes, sharp curves, endless hills, lush forests and off-road stretches.
